avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces glyburide levels, decreasing glucose-lowering efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, monitor blood glucose closely and adjust glyburide dose

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (high-dose supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates insulin secretion and glucose-lowering effects, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; counsel on hypoglycemia symptoms

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhances glucose-lowering effects of glyburide, significantly increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if patient insists, monitor blood glucose frequently

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; may require glyburide dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on hypoglycemia awareness; monitor glucose if used

caution_supplements.name: Bitter melon
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin secretion and glucose utilization
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose levels; educate on hypoglycemia symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive/chronic use)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Impairs hepatic gluconeogenesis and potentiates hypoglycemic effects; increases lactic acidosis risk
avoid_foods.action: Advise strict alcohol limitation; counsel on severe hypoglycemia risk with concurrent use

caution_foods.name: High-carbohydrate/refined sugar meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption may necessitate increased glyburide dosing; poor glycemic control
caution_foods.action: Recommend consistent carbohydrate intake and complex carbohydrates; reinforce dietary counseling

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase glyburide levels slightly
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit juice consumption; monitor glucose response

monitoring_notes: Monitor fasting and postprandial glucose levels regularly; assess for hypoglycemic episodes, especially when supplements or dietary changes are introduced. Educate patients on consistent meal timing and carbohydrate intake to optimize glyburide efficacy.
